name: Raw Brutalist
description: Square corners, heavy raw borders, solid surfaces, compact density, no shadows, no motion, and a noise texture.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's raw-brutal recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, the state transforms are none and motion is instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: A decorative gradient texture sits behind surfaces.

tokens.texture: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 20%, transparent) 0 1px, transparent 1.25px)
